name: amsoft-agentic-workflows
description: AMSoft's reviewed workflows, including a delivery-focused SDLC loop that carries one foreground issue through implementation, two-pass review, verification, merge, staging deployment, and staging verification.

interface.shortDescription: Reviewed AMSoft workflows in one plugin.
interface.longDescription: A central AMSoft plugin for reviewed agentic workflows. WordPress Content is a lightweight workflow independent of Standard Development Workflow: theme, blocks, patterns, layout and copy are prepared with temporary files, verified locally in a browser, applied live with a rollback ready, and rolled back on failed live verification. Software delivery, WordPress DevOps, and optional Git synchronization remain separate capabilities.
defaultPrompt: Onboard me to AMSoft Agentic Workflows and check only the relevant prerequisites.
Run this repository change with Standard Development Workflow.
Use $amsoft-sdlc-loop to deliver one foreground issue through merge and verified staging.
